---
title: "site_bioclim"
output: html_document
---

Purpose: long-term climate at each modeling site (CHELSA v2.1 bioclim, 1981-2010, 30 arc-seconds
~1 km, the grid of the KG raster used in `01_model_data.Rmd`). The swab-date weather in the model
data is "climate at sampling time" (a site surveyed only in midsummer looks warm), so it cannot
describe a site's climate. Used downstream for (README `size_bd_contrast/README.md`, "Downstream
models"):

- between-site climate terms in `size_bd_contrast/04_contrast_environment_screen.qmd` (Q8)
- species-typical climate in the predictive model (mean over a species' sites, each site
  weighted equally, so heavily sampled sites do not set a species' typical climate; written to
  `intermediates/species_bioclim.csv`)
- site-climate moderators in per-species moderation fits (option B), if pursued

Variables (decided 2026-11-26): the mean and the seasonality of each climate variable.

| CHELSA | name here | meaning | unit (after scaling) |
|---|---|---|---|
| bio1 | `bio1_temp_mean` | annual mean air temperature | degrees C |
| bio4 | `bio4_temp_seasonality` | sd of monthly mean temperatures | degrees C / 100 (CHELSA convention, see check below) |
| bio12 | `bio12_precip_annual` | annual precipitation | mm (kg m-2 year-1) |
| bio15 | `bio15_precip_seasonality` | coefficient of variation of monthly precipitation | % |

Kept separate from `01_model_data.Rmd` so the model data `.RData` that every analysis loads does
not change. Run order: `01_model_data.Rmd` (writes the site table), the download below, then this
script.

**Download (once, by hand)** into `data/chelsa_bioclim/` (gitignored with the rest of `data/`):
one global GeoTIFF per variable, ~100-400 MB each, from the CHELSA v2.1 climatologies
(https://chelsa-climate.org, "Downloads" -> V2.1 -> GLOBAL -> climatologies -> 1981-2010 -> bio).
File names: `CHELSA_bio1_1981-2010_V.2.1.tif` (and bio4, bio12, bio15). At the time of writing the
files were served under
`https://os.zhdk.cloud.switch.ch/chelsav2/GLOBAL/climatologies/1981-2010/bio/` (older links:
`.../envicloud/chelsa/chelsa_V2/GLOBAL/climatologies/1981-2010/bio/`); check the download page if
these move.

Optional, for the elevation check: a 30 arc-second DEM at `data/chelsa_bioclim/dem_30s.tif`
(e.g. `geodata::elevation_global(res = 0.5, path = here("data", "chelsa_bioclim"))`, then rename).
Without it the check is skipped.

# Setup
```{r}
#| eval: true
#| output: false
#| code-fold: true
#| code-summary: "Show setup code"

librarian::shelf(tidyverse, here, terra)

chelsa_dir = here("data", "chelsa_bioclim")
intermediates_dir = here("size_bd_unified", "intermediates")

# site table written by 01_model_data.Rmd (coordinates, KG zone)
sites = read_csv(file.path(intermediates_dir, "size_bd_modeling_sites.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(site = as.character(site))

# recorded site elevation, from the model data (present for some sites only)
load(here("size_bd_unified", "intermediates", "bd_model_env_unified_2026-11-12.RData"))
site_elevation = brms_data %>%
  mutate(site = as.character(site)) %>%
  group_by(site) %>%
  summarise(site_elevation_m = mean(site_elevation_m, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(site_elevation_m = if_else(is.nan(site_elevation_m), NA_real_, site_elevation_m))
# which species were swabbed at which sites (for species-typical climate)
species_sites = brms_data %>%
  distinct(taxon_capture, site = as.character(site))
rm(brms_data)

```

# Rasters
```{r}
bioclim_vars = c(bio1_temp_mean = "bio01", bio4_temp_seasonality = "bio04",
                 bio12_precip_annual = "bio12", bio15_precip_seasonality = "bio15")

bioclim_files = file.path(chelsa_dir, paste0("CHELSA_", bioclim_vars, "_1981-2010_V.2.1.tif"))
missing_files = bioclim_files[!file.exists(bioclim_files)]
if (length(missing_files) > 0) {
  stop("CHELSA files not found (see the download note at the top):\n  ",
       paste(missing_files, collapse = "\n  "))
}

bioclim = rast(bioclim_files)
names(bioclim) = names(bioclim_vars)
bioclim

```

# Extract at sites
```{r}
site_points = vect(sites, geom = c("site_longitude", "site_latitude"), crs = "EPSG:4326")

site_bioclim = sites %>%
  select(site, site_latitude, site_longitude, kg_code_3) %>%
  bind_cols(terra::extract(bioclim, site_points, ID = FALSE))

# sites on a coast or a no-data cell get NA: fall back to the mean of valid cells within 1.5 km,
# then 5 km, and record which sites needed it
fill_na_sites = function(df, radius_m) {
  na_rows = which(!complete.cases(df[, names(bioclim_vars)]))
  if (length(na_rows) == 0) return(df)
  buffers = buffer(site_points[na_rows], width = radius_m)
  filled = terra::extract(bioclim, buffers, fun = mean, na.rm = TRUE, ID = FALSE)
  for (v in names(bioclim_vars)) {
    df[[v]][na_rows] = coalesce(df[[v]][na_rows], filled[[v]])
  }
  df$filled_radius_m[na_rows] = if_else(complete.cases(filled), radius_m, df$filled_radius_m[na_rows])
  df
}

site_bioclim = site_bioclim %>%
  mutate(filled_radius_m = NA_real_) %>%
  fill_na_sites(1500) %>%
  fill_na_sites(5000)

# sites filled from neighboring cells, and any still missing
site_bioclim %>% filter(!is.na(filled_radius_m)) %>% count(filled_radius_m)
site_bioclim %>% filter(!complete.cases(across(all_of(names(bioclim_vars)))))

```

# Units
```{r}
# CHELSA v2.1 stores some bioclim layers as scaled integers (e.g. temperature as 0.1 K), with the
# scale and offset in the file metadata, which terra may or may not have applied on reading. the
# documented conversions (CHELSA v2.1 technical specification) are applied only when the raw
# values are clearly unscaled, judged from plausible ranges at these sites (latitude -24 to 47):
#   bio1  annual mean temperature, degrees C: plausible -15 to 30; stored as 0.1 K -> x * 0.1 - 273.15
#   bio4  temperature seasonality: plausible 0 to ~1500 (degrees C / 100); stored x 0.1 -> x * 0.1
#   bio12 annual precipitation, mm: plausible 50 to 8000; stored x 0.1 -> x * 0.1
#   bio15 precipitation seasonality, %: plausible 0 to 250; stored x 0.1 -> x * 0.1
# check the printed ranges against these after any conversion.
raw_ranges = site_bioclim %>%
  summarise(across(all_of(names(bioclim_vars)), list(min = ~ min(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
                                                     median = ~ median(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
                                                     max = ~ max(.x, na.rm = TRUE))))
raw_ranges

if (median(site_bioclim$bio1_temp_mean, na.rm = TRUE) > 200) {
  message("bio1 looks like 0.1 K: converting to degrees C")
  site_bioclim$bio1_temp_mean = site_bioclim$bio1_temp_mean * 0.1 - 273.15
}
if (median(site_bioclim$bio12_precip_annual, na.rm = TRUE) > 8000) {
  message("bio12 looks scaled x10: converting to mm")
  site_bioclim$bio12_precip_annual = site_bioclim$bio12_precip_annual * 0.1
}
if (median(site_bioclim$bio15_precip_seasonality, na.rm = TRUE) > 250) {
  message("bio15 looks scaled x10: converting to %")
  site_bioclim$bio15_precip_seasonality = site_bioclim$bio15_precip_seasonality * 0.1
}
if (median(site_bioclim$bio4_temp_seasonality, na.rm = TRUE) > 1500) {
  message("bio4 looks scaled x10: converting")
  site_bioclim$bio4_temp_seasonality = site_bioclim$bio4_temp_seasonality * 0.1
}

# after conversion: ranges should sit inside the plausible ranges above
site_bioclim %>%
  summarise(across(all_of(names(bioclim_vars)), list(min = ~ min(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
                                                     median = ~ median(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
                                                     max = ~ max(.x, na.rm = TRUE))))

```

# Checks
```{r}
#| fig-height: 6
#| fig-width: 10

# elevation: a ~1 km cell averages over terrain, so in mountains its elevation (and climate) can
# differ from the site's. diagnostic only (no lapse-rate correction unless mismatches are common):
# sites with a recorded elevation that differs from the cell's by > 300 m (~2 degrees C at a
# typical lapse rate of 6.5 degrees C / km)
dem_file = file.path(chelsa_dir, "dem_30s.tif")
site_bioclim = site_bioclim %>% left_join(site_elevation, by = "site")
if (file.exists(dem_file)) {
  site_bioclim$cell_elevation_m = terra::extract(rast(dem_file), site_points, ID = FALSE)[[1]]
  site_bioclim = site_bioclim %>% mutate(elevation_diff_m = site_elevation_m - cell_elevation_m)

  site_bioclim %>%
    summarise(n_with_both = sum(!is.na(elevation_diff_m)),
              n_diff_gt_300m = sum(abs(elevation_diff_m) > 300, na.rm = TRUE),
              median_abs_diff_m = median(abs(elevation_diff_m), na.rm = TRUE))

  site_bioclim %>% filter(abs(elevation_diff_m) > 300) %>% arrange(desc(abs(elevation_diff_m)))
} else {
  message("no DEM at ", dem_file, ": elevation check skipped")
}

# sanity check against the KG zone: annual mean temperature by zone (tropical A zones warm, D
# zones cold, B dry zones low precipitation)
site_bioclim %>%
  group_by(kg_code_3) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), temp_mean = round(median(bio1_temp_mean), 1),
            precip_annual = round(median(bio12_precip_annual)), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(temp_mean)

# distribution of annual mean temperature across sites, by KG main zone
site_bioclim %>%
  select(site, bio1_temp_mean, kg_code_3) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = bio1_temp_mean, fill = substr(kg_code_3, 1, 1))) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 40) +
  labs(x = "annual mean temperature (CHELSA bio1, degrees C)", y = "sites", fill = "KG zone") +
  theme_classic()

```

# Species-typical climate
```{r}
# per species: mean over the sites where it was swabbed, each site weighted equally (decided
# 2026-11-26: heavily sampled sites should not set a species' typical climate), plus the range
# (max - min) across its sites as a climate-breadth measure. for the predictive model
# (size_bd_contrast/README.md, "Downstream models")
species_bioclim = species_sites %>%
  inner_join(site_bioclim %>% select(site, all_of(names(bioclim_vars))), by = "site") %>%
  group_by(taxon_capture) %>%
  summarise(n_sites = n(),
            across(all_of(names(bioclim_vars)),
                   list(mean = ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
                        range = ~ max(.x, na.rm = TRUE) - min(.x, na.rm = TRUE))),
            .groups = "drop")

species_bioclim %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.double), ~ round(.x, 1))) %>%
  arrange(bio1_temp_mean_mean)

```

# Export
```{r}
write_csv(site_bioclim, file.path(intermediates_dir, "site_bioclim.csv"))
write_csv(species_bioclim, file.path(intermediates_dir, "species_bioclim.csv"))

```
